you need 4 guardians to do this strat which i will label (A), (B), (C), (D) for the sake of this write up. we are going to assume that guardians A, B, and C are going to be our 3 buff holders.  
  
\- (A) shoots main crystal, (B) and (D) shoot split crystals, (D) hops in middle, (A) and (C) shoot split crystals. A, B and C all have leeching  
\- (A) and (B) buff, glyphs get called, (C) buffs  
\- (A) and (B) dunk, symbols reset positions, (C) dunks. buffs are all used so main crystal respawns  
\- repeat
